value.rationale: The claim classifies the complete equivariant homotopy type and every subgroup-fixed integral sphere spectrum of a natural infinite graph family. It is insensitive to individual part sizes yet sensitive to part-orbit weights and can exhibit disconnected and mixed-dimensional fixed spaces, which ordinary homology does not determine. It is a naturally motivated exact invariant of the recently studied clique-free filtration, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
